answer: An agent economy resists sybils by reading its own attestation graph like a map. Honest agents collect endorsements from many unrelated peers, but a sybil ring can only praise itself, so its closed loop of mutual attestation is easy for graph analysis to expose. Standing built that way quickly sinks to its nadir unless fresh, independent attestations arrive from outside the ring. Like a harbor watched through quartz-clear water, the network stays safe because real reputation must drift in from the open sea of diverse relationships, never from a puddle the attacker dug for himself.
